description: What is still open in a month before it is locked: expenses waiting to be sorted, bank lines not recorded, card fee reviews, accounts not reconciled, drafts, scheduled entries that did not post, and expenses with no receipt. It also says whether the month has ended and whether it is locked. It only counts: locking the month is done by a person in Mobile Accounting.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

month.description: The month, yyyy-MM. Leave empty for the month after the lock date, or last month when nothing is locked.
